dedupe_keys.name: stationnement cyclable sur la commune d anglet

description: Stationnement cyclable sur la commune d'Anglet is a dataset listed in Anglet Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Ville d'Anglet. Ce jeu de données décrit la localisation des parkings vélos gérés par la ville sur la commune d'Anglet ainsi que ses caractéristiques (type d'accroche, type de mobilier, capacité, couverture, protection, lumière, etc). Il respecte le schéma national de données pour le stationnement cyclable ( version 1.1.1 ). La documentation externe du schéma est consultable ici. Coverage: Anglet. The portal files it under Mobilité, Espace Public. Its keywords are transport, vélo, stationnement, parking, mobilité douce, stationnement cyclable. The portal shows 189 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-anglet-opendatapaysbasque-portal.
